messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from the PM: we need a customer-facing summary and a clear policy for sharing RCAs. Theres a recurring pattern tied to KV/prefix eviction under burst traffic, would like to avoid implementation detail leaks.

ryan: Agreed. My proposal: publish a 3-paragraph status page update + short FAQ. Offer redacted RCAs to enterprise customers on request; public RCA only if impact meets threshold X.

olivia: I can draft the status blurb. Two asks: can someone confirm the short-term mitigations we deployed and a succinct non-technical cause statement?

drew: Mitigations: accelerated autoscale (burst nodes) and increased cache TTL for sensitive keys. Cause (high-level): an unexpected eviction interaction under extreme concurrency that increased request latency.

ops-bot: Created ticket COMMS-991 to track external summary. Assigned to olivia.

legal-team: Reminder: avoid detailed timelines that could be construed as admission of SLA breach. Also we require confirmation that no PII was exposed before publishing.

ana: (typo) ana: @legal-team noted. We have confirmed no PII or customer data was exposed per forensic check. Please include that sentence prominently.

customer-advocate: For enterprise customers we should proactively offer a redacted RCA and a call to review the remediation timeline. Some customers expect more than a status page note.

ryan: OK actions: 1) olivia draft status page + 2-line FAQ (due: 2026-03-29), 2) ops (drew) provide a one-paragraph mitigation summary to include (due: 2026-03-28), 3) legal confirm wording and PII statement (due: 24h after draft), 4) customer-advocate to prepare outreach list for proactive contact (due: 2026-03-30).

olivia: Draft (first pass):

"On 2026-03-22 we experienced increased latency for a subset of inference requests during a high-concurrency event. We applied short-term mitigations to restore service, and are implementing a permanent fix. No customer data was exposed. Enterprise customers may request a redacted RCA and remediation timeline."

legal-team: Suggest replacing "permanent fix" with "long-term fix" and removing explicit dates unless we reference the incident time as "on March 22" (no year). Also we prefer "redacted root cause analysis" phrasing.

olivia: Updated draft with legal suggestions and posted to #eng for quick review.

ana: Small wording tweak: replace "may request" with "can request" to be more actionable.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-31 to verify COMMS-991 closure and that INF-5033 remediation ticket stays on track.

drew: INF-5033 (remediation for eviction heuristics) ETA: 2 weeks for deploy to prod, longer for validation under mixed workloads. I'll post weekly status to the ticket.

ana: Final action recap (copy to postmortem tracker):
- olivia: Finalize status page blurb + 2-line FAQ and submit for legal review (due: 2026-03-29) [owner: olivia]
- drew: Provide mitigation summary + remediation ETA (due: 2026-03-28) [owner: drew]
- legal-team: Approve customer-facing wording and confirm PII statement (due: 24h after draft) [owner: legal-team]
- customer-advocate: Prepare enterprise outreach list and draft outreach email (due: 2026-03-30) [owner: customer-advocate]
- ryan: Decide threshold X and public RCA policy language and update site policy doc (due: 2026-04-02) [owner: ryan]

ana: Please update this thread when your items are done so we can close the loop. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
